pairs.query: how do I roll back a production deploy
pairs.notes: Prose runbook; multi-term query, every leg should fire.

pairs.query: what caused the checkout outage and what is the follow-up
pairs.notes: Prose postmortem; shares 'checkout/flow' with flags-json but wins on caused/outage/follow-up.

R39.2 regression: bare opaque code. The code appears once in a long doc, so hash-embedding cosine stays under the 0.2 floor (like a real embedder's no-signal direction) and the summary carries no code tokens, so only the keyword leg fires. Fused must still hit via the keyword floor.
Second R39.2 pin: the postmortem's other unique all-caps code, same floor-only signature.

pairs.query: when did the gateway alert page the on-call engineer
pairs.notes: Mid-body signal the TOC fence hides (R36.7 ai-03 shape): no summary carries gateway/alert/page/call/engineer except pagerduty's ('alert'), so TOC admits only the wrong section while both flat legs fire; fused must still hit via the discounted floor.

pairs.query: how does the DD cancellation process differ from the implemented code
pairs.notes: R40.6 (1.0.29 field case): vocabulary mismatch — the RFP says 'reversal'/'Direct Debit', the query says 'cancellation'/'DD'. Misses every leg before synonym expansion; the keyword leg hits after and keyword slots carry it to fused.

pairs.query: when is the escrow timetable
pairs.notes: R40.5: continuation-chunk signal — 'escrow'/'timetable' live in the section heading, not the chunk bytes (production sections split so only the first chunk holds the heading line; the rest carry it via chunks.path into embed_input). The vector leg misses on bare content vectors and hits on heading-prefixed input; keyword/TOC stay dark (FTS is content-only, TOC leaf is keyword-gated without vec0).

pairs.query: what is dunning
pairs.notes: R40.7: corpus vocabulary end to end — 'dunning' appears in no body; the seeded active pair expands the keyword leg to the 'payment reminder' phrase (3x in the doc). Misses every leg with no vocab row; keyword + TOC-leaf hit with it (the merge rides the shared FTS query builder, so both keyword paths expand).

pairs.query: which route do forklifts take through the freezer aisle
pairs.notes: R46.12: an unplaced image found only through a person's caption (kind='caption' chunk, no section, no summary) — TOC cannot see it, so the vector + keyword floors carry it; fused must still rank it.
